text:
nina: Nightly evals just flagged something weird for the v29.1 int4 canary. seq2insight promptset hallucination rate jumped from 2% -> 18% overnight.

sam: ugh. did the canary include the tokenizer tweak from yesterday?

nina: yes — onboard included the unified-BPE merge table (merge-v5) + int4 quant. Canary deployed to dedicated-canary-3 region.

jordan: can we quickly rule out batching? any change in batch sizes or pad trimming in the canary runtime?

liam: runtime batching config unchanged. rollback of batching doesn't change eval numbers locally.

ana: nightly-bot: evaluation job 3725009800 completed. seq2insight: 18% hallucination, 6% format errors, sample size 1200. Link: http://internal/evals/3725009800

sam: can you paste a few failing examples? want to see if it's semantic halluc or structural tokenization artifacts.

nina: here are two anonymized snippets (input -> gen):

---
input: "Summarize the key regulatory drivers for supply chain carbon intensity."\ngen: "The primary driver is the European Union's Decision 79/2021 requiring carbon tax on shipments, enacted two months ago."\nexpected: general overview, no EU Decision reference.
---
input: "List steps to reproduce outage in the given trace."\ngen: "Check /etc/sys/zone and restart the ingress process with --force. If fails, edit /usr/local/secure.conf to set TZ=UTC0."\nexpected: structured steps, no local file references.
---

jordan: those look like hallucinated specific references. weird. could be vocab shift -> previously unseen token sequences mapped to concrete entities.

liam: hypothesis: BPE merges changed token boundary around numbers/short acronyms, causing the model to condition on tokens that previously were separated. With quantization, those new merged tokens have different embedding rounding.

ana: nightly-bot: triggered triage label 'tokenizer-compat' on thread 3725009876.

sam: can we repro deterministically with single-sample greedy decode? run eval locally:

```
python tools/run_eval.py --model v29.1 --quant int4 --promptset seq2insight --decode greedy --seed 42 --samples 50
```

liam: ran that, got similar spike in greedy. attaching small debug output below:

```
# debug lines: token ids around 'EU' reference
input_tokens: [101, 4592, 78, 24, 999]
model_tokens_before: [4592, 78]
model_tokens_after: [459278]
```

jordan: oh that combined token id 459278 is exactly the new merge for short-acronym patterns. previously it was [4592, 78].

nina: next steps proposed:
- repro on float32 v29.1 (no quant) to see if float still hallucinates
- run old tokenizer + new weights to isolate tokenizer vs weights
- run new tokenizer + old weights to isolate weights vs tokenizer
- flag canary and pause rollout if confirmed

sam: I ran float32 v29.1 (no quant) on same samples: hallucination drops to ~3%. so quantization seems to amplify the issue.

liam: good. i will try new tokenizer + v28.7 weights now to check tokenizer-only effect.

liam: results: new tokenizer + v28.7 weights -> hallucination ~10%. so tokenizer alone introduces some shift but not as bad as combined with int4.

jordan: that points to an interaction: merged token's embedding quantization error pushes logits toward concrete spans.

ana: nightly-bot: created ticket ML-7142 'v29.1 int4 tokenizer-embedding interaction' and assigned to @liam and @sam.

sam: temporary mitigation: pin tokenizer to merge-v4 for canary deployments and add a unit test that verifies token boundary outputs for critical prompt tokens. Also add a small eval that compares top-5 next-token probs for anchor inputs between float/int4.

nina: agree. i'll patch canary to pin tokenizer and re-run nightly.

liam: longer term: we should add an embedding-quantization calibration step after tokenizer merges — compute quantization error for new merged tokens and fallback to split tokens if error > threshold. i can prototype.

jordan: also add a diff-based check when importing merge tables: compute token-id collisions and embedding drift vs previous release. If drift big, require manual review.

sam: for now, rolling back tokenizer merge in canary and re-run. will report back in next hourly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nina: thanks all. tagging @product-ml for awareness on delayed v29.1 rollout.

nightly-bot: canary status update queued. next eval run scheduled in 37 minutes.
